plans.idea: Faithful centred stack like the original: brand seal on top, then phone, then 'Glow.', then a one-line CTA. The whole column sits on one central axis and is shifted down so the top and bottom spacing even out.

Headline first: 'Glow.' opens the skyscraper at the top, the phone fills the middle, a one-line CTA follows, and the brand seal closes the column, centred, as a sign-off, so the reading order runs top to bottom.

The brand seal and 'Glow.' sit together as a masthead at the top, the phone takes the full width as a big centrepiece, and the CTA sits alone at the very bottom like a footer button, giving clear top, middle and bottom zones.
